title: Theduckguyya's NoPumpkinBlur
description: This resourcepack removes the annoying pumpkin blur in minecraft. Perfect for hiding in your friend's world
body:
# What is Theduckguyya's NoPumpkinblur pack?

Theduckguyya's NoPumpkinblur pack is a resourcepack built so that you dont have to deal with the annoying built in pumpkinblur in vanilla Minecraft. It is perfect if you are trying to hide from your friends in your base.
